apps.name: FRC Scout
apps.subtitle: Match, pit, picklist and strategy board
apps.localizedDescription: iPad scouting for FRC REBUILT: count fuel and climbs per robot, pit scout with the robustness rubric, sort teams, build a picklist, and draw plays on the field. Scouts hand data to the lead with QR codes, no Wi-Fi needed.

versions.localizedDescription: Easier on phones: match sections in match order, labeled questions, a Board that fits the iPhone screen, back to the top after every save, and a quick Saved banner when team sync is on.
Now runs on iPhone too. Team sync with the web and Android apps, match picker with only real matches, whole-match scouting, weighted picklist, pre-scouting, past events, live EPA, and more.
First release: match and pit scouting, team table, picklist, strategy board, QR sync, TBA and Nexus downloads.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: FRC Scout uses the camera to scan scouting QR codes.
